subject.title: Bug: Billing error (402) causes infinite retry death spiral for inline-apiKey providers (no backoff)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt provider-level fail-closed cooldown state for inline `models.providers.<id>.apiKey` credentials, or keep cooldowns limited to auth profiles and document auth-profile migration as the supported path?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the durable inline-key cooldown namespace and fail-closed upgrade behavior are auth-provider policy choices that should be accepted before the linked PR lands.

options.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
options.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys get the same billing/auth cooldown protection as profile-backed credentials.

options.title: Keep profile-only cooldowns
options.body: Document moving inline keys into auth profiles as the supported workaround and close the implementation path as not planned.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers specify the exact cooldown identity, persistence, and recovery behavior they want.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-level cooldown
recommendation.body: Land or rebuild the linked fix so inline keys get the same billing/auth cooldown protection as profile-backed credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and issue timeline make steipete the best available routing owner for the auth-provider policy choice.
